brief:
Ibrahim Rabaa has spent nearly three years filming fragments of his life amid Israel's military operations in Gaza, Al Jazeera English reported. The photographer's work captures the daily reality of Palestinians living through sustained conflict in the territory.

Rabaa's camera has documented the ongoing situation as the humanitarian crisis deepens across Gaza, creating a visual record of civilian life under prolonged military pressure.
dek: For almost three years, Ibrahim Rabaa has filmed fragments of his life through Israel’s genocide in Gaza.
title: Photographer documents three years of genocide in Gaza
